package integration_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestHTTPGeneratedCRUDV1(t *testing.T) {
	engineRequest(t, "POST", "/widgets", "", "application/json", bytes.NewBufferString("{"), 400)
	engineRequest(t, "POST", "/widgets", "", "application/json", bytes.NewBufferString("{}"), 400)
	data := engineRequest(t, "POST", "/widgets", "", "application/json", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"name":"Generated widget"}`), 201)
	var result struct {
		Success bool `json:"success"`
		Data    struct {
			ID   uint   `json:"id"`
			Name string `json:"name"`
		} `json:"data"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &result))
	require.True(t, result.Success)
	require.NotZero(t, result.Data.ID)
	require.Equal(t, "Generated widget", result.Data.Name)
	path := fmt.Sprintf("/widgets/%d", result.Data.ID)
	data = engineRequest(t, "GET", path, "", "application/json", http.NoBody, 200)
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &result))
	require.Equal(t, "Generated widget", result.Data.Name)
	data = engineRequest(t, "GET", "/widgets?page=1&limit=5", "", "application/json", http.NoBody, 200)
	require.Contains(t, string(data), "Generated widget")
	engineRequest(t, "GET", "/widgets?page=invalid", "", "application/json", http.NoBody, 400)
	engineRequest(t, "GET", "/widgets/invalid", "", "application/json", http.NoBody, 400)
	data = engineRequest(t, "PUT", path, "", "application/json", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"name":"Updated widget"}`), 200)
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &result))
	require.Equal(t, "Updated widget", result.Data.Name)
	require.Empty(t, engineRequest(t, "DELETE", path, "", "application/json", http.NoBody, 204))
	engineRequest(t, "GET", path, "", "application/json", http.NoBody, 404)
}
